hitl_firmware.board: Pixhawk 6C (px4_fmu-v6c_default); CubePilot Cube Orange+ (cubepilot_cubeorangeplus_hil, see fc/cubeorangeplus.md)
hitl_firmware.note: The FC firmware is built from this lock per deploy recipe (px4/build_firmware.py); deploy/00_native keeps a prebuilt native image. Each recipe's deploy/<recipe>/firmware/firmware.json records the identity the FC reports (embedded) and the last flash (flashed). At handover the FC runs deploy/01_sdfix, flashed 2026-10-18 07:22 UTC by ./runbridge deploy-test --flash. Cube Orange+ (2026-10-20): its recipes are deploy/*_cubeorangeplus; at handover that FC runs deploy/01_sdfix_cubeorangeplus, flashed 2026-10-20 09:10 UTC by ./runbridge deploy-test --flash.
